Async mount — tries the rust/glitch artifact on the session canvas. On success the session's wasm field goes live and tick switches to frameGlitchWasm; on ANY failure (artifact, init, decode) the 2D backend is claimed — the session stays alive either way unless the 2D claim also fails, in which case the overlay is dropped and the plain is the final fallback.
